text:
Using Grok Bot to cancel services is pretty magical. It just figures it all out, on its own.

I literally had to ask it how it was able to cancel because I wanted to know.

It couldn’t login to canceled so rather than getting stuck and asking me, it clicked a manage plan link in an email, got a one time sign in email sent, and then used that to cancel 😅 

My bot is officially one step ahead of me.
